CODE LOGIC (be/src/routes.ts login/register/findUsersByEmail, be/test/r20-fixes.test.ts): no real defect found. Register and login both key on normalizeEmail (NFC, trim, lower, NFC), so NFC/NFD/UPPER spellings share one rate-limit bucket (loginfail:ip:email) and the demo-domain check runs on the normalised key. Exact-match row first, scan only for non-ASCII keys and excludes the exact row (no duplicates). Candidates with is_demo_account are skipped when DEMO_MODE is off; if none was checked a dummy scrypt hash of valid shape (16-byte salt, 32-byte key) is verified, so existing, missing and demo-off accounts do one scrypt and return the same 401. issue(u) and game.me(u.id) use the verified candidate's own id, so no session mix-up. Failure slots are reserved before the awaited scrypt and given back on success; RateLimiter.release pops the latest hit of the key, which can pop another concurrent request's slot, but the net count is unchanged (pre-existing, not part of round 20). Known and documented residuals: one scrypt per legacy row (KL item 12(c), R22-A-01), non-ASCII scan cost (R21-A-02), zero-width characters accepted in e-mail (R21-A-03). Tests: 7 tests, every assertion consistent with the code (NFC/NFD constants are different strings, guarded by assert.notEqual).
